description: Minimal surface: core defaults, plus window dragging. Deliberately NO shell permissions — the sidecar is spawned Rust-side, which bypasses the ACL; the webview gets no shell access at all. core:window:allow-start-dragging is needed because the title bar is ours (titleBarStyle: Overlay): the header's data-tauri-drag-region invokes window|start_dragging, which core:default does not grant, and a denied invoke fails silently — leaving the window impossible to move at all, including to another display. Double-click to zoom kept working throughout, since internal_toggle_maximize IS in the default set, so only half the title bar was broken.
